FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Faction Colors
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds ability to set apparel colors for faction pawns.

patchNoteLines.li: Can set primary and secondary faction colors in the faction customize menu
Can set individual apparel colors for military units in the Manage Units menu
